# Insightly | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Positioning | Modern CRMs for growth-oriented enterprises, emphasizing from marketing opportunities to project delivery and providing marketing, services and integrated platforms. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | The TCO package is significantly higher than a separate CR; AppConnect has tasks, set-up fees, etc.; AI inquiries on quotas and support levels require contract confirmation. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | The TCO package is significantly higher than the individual CR; AppConnect has tasks, set-up fees, etc.; AI query quotas and support levels require contract confirmation. |
